assessments.reasoning: Section 3.3 states a required 460 token despite its earlier general advice. A leading comment is permitted; a preceding extension line is substantive. Omission of a profile token selects core for 460. Omission of the version directive is a different condition. Earlier versions, ESSL and the separate offline SPIR-V behavior restrict applicability.

limitations: The rule leaves API context support, earlier versions, OpenGL ES profiles, and SPIR-V tooling outside the claim.
